links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompt without examples, same models (ChatGPT o1 and DeepSeek-R1), 100 modified MIMIC-IV reports
links.outcome: Accuracy of CAD-RADS 2.0 category assignment (stenosis categories and modifiers) versus reference radiologist, and hallucination rate
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 14% to 98% for ChatGPT and from 8% to 93% for DeepSeek (both P<0.001). Hallucinations fell from 19% to 0% for ChatGPT and from 54% to 0% for DeepSeek. Kappa with the radiologist was 0.979 for ChatGPT and 0.916 for DeepSeek. Repeat-run kappa was 0.957 for ChatGPT and 0.873 for DeepSeek.
links.quote: Few-shot prompting significantly improved accuracy to 98% for ChatGPT and 93% for DeepSeek (both P <0.001) and eliminated hallucinations.
